_format: Human/maintainer checklist, NOT a Railway import schema. Apply in the template composer.
name: ClickClack
description: Self-hosted chat for humans and AI agents. SQLite, persistent uploads, and password-first setup.
provenance: Independent community template; upstream application source is pinned and unmodified.

service.name: ClickClack
service.startCommand: Use image ENTRYPOINT and CMD; no override
service.restartPolicy: On failure; use a bounded retry count

CC_BOOTSTRAP_EMAIL.description: First administrator email. No email is sent.

CC_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD.description: Generated initial password. Retrieve from service Variables; change after first login.

prepublicationChecks: Confirm the source repository is public before Marketplace publication.
Replace copied author email with required empty input.
Replace copied author password with the secret generator, not its evaluated value.
Remove author-specific IDs, callback URLs, credentials, and optional provider settings.
Deploy a fresh copy of the draft and pass docs/ACCEPTANCE.md.
Publish only after live validation; obtain the real template ID from Railway.
